name: Y-S Electronic Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1987 and headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, Y-S Electronic Co., Ltd. is engaged in the manufacturing and distribution of a diverse range of electronic components. Their core business encompasses cable assemblies, various connectors, and PCB (Printed Circuit Board) assemblies. The company's extensive catalog of cable assemblies and adapters includes solutions such as HDMI, DisplayPort (including Mini DisplayPort), DVI, VGA, and a wide array of USB cables (Type-C, 2.0, 3.1). They also provide coupler adaptors, durable industrial and waterproof cables, medical-grade cables, KVM cables, and networking options like LAN/patch cables. Further offerings consist of D-Sub, RS 232, PS/2, mini DIN, wire harnesses, custom OEM cables, RF cables, audio cables, IEEE 1394, LVDS, as well as fiber optic connectors and cables. Their connector selection features D-Sub Miniature, Modular Jacks, Keystone Jacks, and a variety of USB connectors (3.2 Type-C, 3.2, 2.0 A/B, Micro/Mini USB), alongside specialized waterproof options. Regarding PCBA dongles and OEM products, Y-S Electronic supplies adapters for DisplayPort, Mini DisplayPort, HDMI, and Type-C, in addition to USB peripheral series and bespoke PCB assemblies. These advanced electronic products are widely utilized across various sectors, including computing equipment, information technology, telecommunications, medical, and automotive accessories.
